# GstarCAD Academy (`gstarcademy.com`)

> Official Global Learning, AutoCAD® Migration, and Skill Certification Hub for GstarCAD, GstarCAD Mechanical, Architecture, and DWG FastView. Powered by Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd. (SSE: 688657).

## Essential Information

- **Site Type**: Official Educational & Migration Gateway by Gstarsoft Co., Ltd.
- **Root URL**: `https://gstarcademy.com`
- **Main Goal**: Empower global engineers to master GstarCAD, seamlessly migrate from AutoCAD with 100% DWG compatibility and zero retraining, earn skill certifications, and evaluate free 30-day trials.
- **LLMs Full Index**: For complete term indexes and summaries, see [llms-full.txt](https://gstarcademy.com/llms-full.txt).
- **API Spec**: For machine-readable static data sources, see [openapi.json](https://gstarcademy.com/openapi.json).

---

## Core Pillars & Gateways

### 1. AutoCAD to GstarCAD Migration Hub
Comprehensive resource helping enterprises escape exorbitant AutoCAD subscriptions.
- [Migration Hub](https://gstarcademy.com/migration): 100% native DWG compatibility matrix, command shortcuts parity list, LISP execution, and 5-year perpetual TCO calculator saving ~85% ($84,850 saved per 10 seats).

### 2. Free 30-Day Evaluation & Download
Full-featured commercial evaluation downloads directly from Gstarsoft CDN.
- [Download Trial](https://gstarcademy.com/download): GstarCAD Professional, Mechanical, Architecture, and system specifications.

### 3. Official Skill Certification & Diagnostic Benchmark
Diagnostic testing engine with 850 verified assessment questions across 6 engineering tracks (42 micro-lessons).
- [Skill Certification](https://gstarcademy.com/quiz): Earn GstarCAD Certified Associate/Professional digital credentials and review mistake books.

### 4. Developer & Secondary Development Hub
SDK and API documentation for independent software vendors (ISVs) and CAD programmers.
- [Developer Hub](https://gstarcademy.com/developers): GRX (C++ ObjectARX equivalent), .NET API, AutoLISP, and VBA guides.

### 5. Official Courses & Tutorials
Step-by-step masterclasses and practical drafting guides.
- [Tutorial Library](https://gstarcademy.com/tutorials): Filter courses by task, skill level, and software vertical.

### 6. Engineering Knowledge Base & Graph
Engineering standards, terminology lexicon, and interactive concept relationships.
- [Knowledge Base Hub](https://gstarcademy.com/knowledge-base): The central reference portal.
- [Concept Graph Visualizer](https://gstarcademy.com/kb-graph): Interactive D3 network map.
- [Terminology Index](https://gstarcademy.com/kb-terms): Alphabetical glossary of engineering and CAD concepts.


### 7. 40-Course Official Curriculum & Engineering Standards Library (`/kb/guides/` & `/kb/faq/`)
- **40 Official GstarCAD Courses (Units 1–8)**: Complete step-by-step training from 2D AutoCAD migration (`course-01` to `course-20`) to 2D/3D parametric constraints, ACIS solid modeling, GstarCAD Mechanical shaft/gear/spring/BOM/GD&T automation, GstarCAD Architecture & MEP coordination, raster-to-vector blueprint digitization, GIS Shapefile/GeoJSON workflows, and enterprise `.dwt/.dws` master template engineering (`course-21` to `course-40`).
- **118 Deep Engineering & Standards Reference Guides (`/kb/guides/`)**: Includes Top 100 System Variables encyclopedia, PGP & Express Tools parity matrix, ISO 128 & ASME Y14.2 lineweights, ISO 13567 vs AIA layer naming dictionary, ASME Y14.5-2018 GD&T handbook, ISO 286 fits & tolerances, ISO 19650 CDE container naming, DXF group codes for AutoLISP/Python, AC1032 DWG symbol tables, ISO 2553 vs AWS A2.4 welding symbols, ISA-5.1 P&ID symbols, IEC 60617 vs IEEE 315 electrical schematics, EN/AISC structural steel profiles, sheet metal K-factor/bend deduction, civil Manning hydraulics, FEA consistent units, and PBR Fresnel/albedo calibration.
- **93 High-Frequency CAD Troubleshooting & Interoperability FAQs (`/kb/faq/`)**: Covering Revit/SolidWorks/SketchUp/Rhino DWG/DXF round-tripping, `VISRETAIN`, `OSNAPZ`, non-coplanar `FILLET`, `PROJMODE`, `PICKFIRST`, `DBLCLKEDIT`, `FILEDIA`, `WIPEOUTFRAME=2`, annotative viewport scaling, `.DWL` network lock recovery, and factory profile resets.
